query_feedback: Repair the missing IA Super bow case: the query currently filters that table row out entirely, allowing any IA Super bow frame to pass without evidence. Run the matcher for canonical evidence/path terms expressing strengthening down to the tank top or below the top of floors, then validate that alternative explicitly. Scope ice-class and hull-region readiness checks to frames in IA Super, IA, IB, or IC rather than requiring them unconditionally on every frame. Do not use a boolean stating that adjacent-boundary termination is permitted as evidence that termination actually occurred; the exception must require extension <= 250 mm together with canonical termination-at-boundary evidence. Replace the simple upper-bow-belt SPARQL constraint with SHACL Core conditional alternatives and use at most one bounded table-lookup query for the numeric rows, preserving the >= minima and <= 250 mm direction.

query_feedback: Rebuild the constraint to avoid accidental passes. Enforce the Table 4-6 minima by default for applicable IA Super/IA/IB/IC frames, using bounded SHACL Core alternatives by ice class and hull region; do not gate all checks on the presence of an extension value. Model the exception in its stated direction: only an explicit extensionBeyondAdjacentDeckOrTankBoundary value <= 250 mm permits termination at that boundary, using the supplied canonical termination-permission term where appropriate. Keep the 1.2 m above-UIWL minimum for IA Super bow; the current FILTER exclusion wrongly removes that requirement entirely. IA Super bow also requires qualitative below-LIWL evidence of reaching the tank top or below the top of floors; activate the matcher to locate the canonical property/value needed for that evidence. Add appropriate minCount/maxCount constraints for applicability inputs and single-valued booleans/quantities so missing or conflicting values cannot pass through vacuous OR, NOT EXISTS, or hasValue logic.

feedback_appendix: Use this exact term because it is the canonical millimetre-valued quantity property for the explicit extension beyond an adjacent deck or tank boundary in TRF-043; only a value at or below 250 mm may support the stated termination exception.
